announcements.headline: PDMR & PCA Dealings
announcements.insight: Routine disclosure of Personal Data Manager dealings typically carries minimal immediate market impact unless accompanied by unusual volume or timing relative to price movements; without specific transaction details indicating significant insider conviction or divergence, this remains an administrative filing.

announcements.headline: PDMR Dealings, Treasury Transfer & TVR
announcements.insight: Routine PDMR dealings and treasury transfers are standard administrative disclosures for SOLI, lacking the transformative catalysts required to move the stock price in the volatile small-cap space.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results, Analyst Briefing, Investor Pres
announcements.insight: Solid State's release of interim results provides critical visibility into its transition from R&D to commercial manufacturing, a pivotal moment for the UK semiconductor sector. The accompanying analyst briefing will likely focus on yield improvements and customer qualification progress, which are key indicators of execution risk in the power electronics supply chain.
